evidence: Beginning from the Lake Matheson carpark, follow the Lake Matheson/Te Ara Kairaumati walk in an anti-clockwise direction before branching off to Lake Gault.
As the track flattens out, you’ll catch glimpses of Lake Gault through the vegetation. Continue several minutes to the lookout point.
The track starts from the Lake Matheson carpark.

doubts: The end is the lookout point (with a shelter) above Lake Gault; the ref given is the lake itself (T4), as no entry is the lookout. The 'anti-clockwise direction' refers to the Lake Matheson walk followed on the way out, not to this out-and-back walk. The branch-off point from the Lake Matheson walk is not named.
